scope: Isolated real Chromium/extension; three semantic clicks after reload. Investigative trace, not a timing benchmark.
inference: Parent scrolling updated geometry before the compositor routed a complete gesture to the child. Pointer down and up reached different documents; no child click was produced.
fix: Wait for rendered frames after actual iframe-owner scrolling, before pointer dispatch. Do not resend a click.
regression: tests/browser-e2e.test.mjs: actions through shadow DOM and cross-origin frame
